thread:
Priya: Heads-up — customer asked us to onboard a new model called midnight-shed-13b (private deployment). They want p95 latency <150ms and cost parity with our 13B tier. Can we triage and estimate effort?
Sam: @eng-ml tagging for intake. Do we have any red flags for quantization/compat? :eyes:
Jorge: Quick glance — model uses rotary embeddings with a RoPE variant; might need attention kernel checks. I can start a compatibility pass on a4 nodes.
Leah: I can pick up quant experiments. Plan: PTQ (bitsandbytes) then QAT if needed. Need dataset/examples from customer to run evals. ETA 48h for first pass.
Priya: Uploaded their 200 example prompts to the shared drive (link: https://redwood.internal/s/midnight-shed/examples). Also added a short spec: latency goal, safety filters, and a few heldout reference summaries.
Sam: KMS and S3 access for private deploy should be fine, FYI. We will need a dedicated estimate for 2-week onboarding—likely 2xA10s for canary + smoke. I'll open infra request once we have perf numbers.
Jorge: Starting a quick model sanity run now. Will check aten kernel fallbacks and kv-cache behavior. If we see aten fallback loops that's a blocker.
bench-bot: scheduled perf job 1766123468 on gpu-pool-a. job link: https://bench/redwood/1766123468
bench-bot: job update — smoke finished. raw results: p95 latency 132ms (seq len 128), median 60ms, tokens/sec 58k, GPU mem peak 23.5GB.
Leah: Nice — I will run quant PTQ 4-bit next. Command I'll use: ```
python tools/quantize.py --model midnight-shed-13b --method ptq --backend bitsandbytes --bits 4 --out /tmp/mid-shed-4bit
```
Leah: also running eval harness against their heldout summaries: ```
python tools/eval.py --model /tmp/mid-shed-4bit --dataset customer/heldout_summaries.jsonl --metrics rouge ppl exact_match
```
Jorge: FYI historically similar models saw ~2-4% rouge drop after naive PTQ. If we hit >3% drop we should try QAT or mixed-precision fallback.
Priya: Good call. Customer SLO for quality is within 2% of baseline. Leah, please record metric diffs and attach artifacts to GH issue.
Leah: ack. Starting now, will post results here in ~6h.
Sam: If quantized model meets quality, plan is: (1) private canary in customer VPC, (2) 48h traffic ramp with tracing on, (3) fallback route to fp16 hosted for any regression. Who owns rollout policy?
Jorge: I can draft rollout policy (canary thresholds, automatic rollback on perf/quality regressions). Will post a PR.
Priya: I created GH issue #4221: "onboard midnight-shed-13b — quant + canary" and linked dataset + perf job. Assigned Leah for experiments and Jorge for rollout.
bench-bot: daily perf job scheduled for the next 3 days at 08:00 UTC.
Leah: first PTQ run done — eval summary: rouge-l delta = -1.1%, ppl +0.6, latency p95 improved to 118ms. Artifacts: https://artifacts/redwood/midnight-shed/ptq-run1
Priya: That looks within SLO. Next steps: infra ticket for 2xA10 for canary (Sam), rollout PR (Jorge), and schedule a private canary start for next Tue.
Sam: Opening infra ticket now (TICKET-9876) — requested 2xA10 for 14 days, marked high priority.
Jorge: Drafted rollout PR with canary settings, thresholds, and fallback. cc @Priya for approval.
Priya: Approved. Please include a smoke eval set and auto-alert to ML-ops if rouge drops >2% or p95 increases >30%.
Leah: Will run a targeted regression suite during the canary and post results.
Sam: Noted. Anything else blocking from security/compliance for private deploy?
Priya: Compliance ok, they require KMS key rotation policy which is standard. We're clear.
Leah: starting canary packaging artifacts now and will push image to the private registry.
Priya: Great work team — thanks. I'll update customer success with the canary timeline and handoff notes. :thumbsup:
